purpose: Candidate experiments, not authorization to replace the canonical deployment or evidence that proposed gates have passed.

constraints.timing_boundary: Scheduled prepared-RAM window release to FPGA raw-class completion; acquisition and screen time are separate boundaries.
constraints.hardware_rules: Preserve original overlay. Run no competing job; establish idle and preserve active-run evidence before any reload. New variants require explicit versioned scope, reference, golden data and artifact identity.
constraints.statistical_unit: File or recording; report paired file-level uncertainty and denominators. Repeated windows do not manufacture independent evidence.

experiments.title: Freeze identity, protocol, file-level selection and gate definitions
go_criteria: All proposed changes have declared scope

experiments.title: Actual softmax flat-row numerical reproduction
experiments.actual_evidence: At T256 equal scores, actual IntegerTransformer._softmax returns all zero for signed8, code1 for signed9 and code2 for signed10. No trained-data causal or accuracy conclusion follows.
go_criteria: Use as mechanism hypothesis only; proceed to real validation discrimination
experiments.scope_change: No production model or dataset changes
experiments.run_command: python -c "import runpy; from pathlib import Path; runpy.run_path(str(next(Path('research_notes').glob('*/hardware_pilot.py'))), run_name='__main__')"

experiments.title: Disentangle weight, activation and attention-probability precision
go_criteria: Demonstrated numerical effect on real validation data
No class recall loss >1 percentage point
stop_criteria: Flat-row mechanism absent or unrelated to changed predictions: reject the causal story
experiments.scope_change: Research-only numerical contract, separate scales/export and golden outputs; no canonical replacement

experiments.title: Prove exact legal widths and boundary-equivalent requantization
assumptions: Clamped internal codes [-511,511], not all ap_int<10> bit patterns
experiments.scope_change: Exact implementation specialization; same model, arithmetic meaning, ABI and goldens

experiments.title: Single expensive operator HLS and post-route discrimination
go_criteria: Credible integrated >=10% DSP or >=15% useful timing/latency improvement
experiments.scope_change: Isolated research implementation; no DSP savings asserted in advance

experiments.title: Physical Pareto of selected exact and mixed designs
comparators: Selected mixed variant if gate passes
Combined variant only if both are useful
go_criteria: Every version matches its own reference
Mixed candidate >=15% post-route resource or latency objective improvement
experiments.scope_change: Mixed precision changes numeric contract and goldens explicitly. QAT, if needed, is a separately selected later branch, not included here.

experiments.title: 3072-case deterministic logical vulnerability pilot
experiments.design: 256 validation windows across files/classes; 8 stage groups x3 bit bands x128 deterministic injections. Define exact target widths and transient/persistent/state families.
go_criteria: Useful vulnerability separation supporting cheap selected checks
experiments.scope_change: Exact research C-model hooks; no CRAM, radiation or natural upset-rate claim

experiments.title: One programmable debug overlay with selected integrity checks
go_criteria: Injection-disabled exactness on all original clean/golden inputs
Zero false flags on original 95404 clean inputs
experiments.scope_change: Versioned debug registers and integrity/status metadata; weight-read XOR is logical emulation, not physical configuration-memory mutation

experiments.title: Held-out physical injection and bounded recovery
go_criteria: >=80% silent raw/stable class corruption reduction on untouched confirmation manifest if sample counts support conclusion
Zero normal-operation deadline misses over predefined 30000 scored windows
limitations: Invalid frames are not successful classifications
Full inference retry cannot be assumed to fit 20.48ms
experiments.scope_change: Research-only invalid/status and state-recovery policy; preserve production overlay reloadability

experiments.title: Front-end transfer boundary and quality-plus-margin selection
metrics: Reference numeric deviation vs true-label error separately
go_criteria: >=30% relative reduction in wrong accepted corruption outputs
No hidden false-healthy or long-rejection penalty
stop_criteria: Margin alone dominates combined method: prefer simpler method
experiments.scope_change: Validation-only thresholds, channel-specific tach safeguards; no new fifth class or conformal guarantee

experiments.title: Physical input-boundary pack and versioned status output
metrics: Burst onset/recovery and accepted wrong decisions
experiments.scope_change: Separate input_quality/decision_status metadata; digital replay proves integer path, not analog front-end or real sensor performance

experiments.title: Finite-horizon evidence at matched false-switch budget
go_criteria: >=20% lower p95 delay versus best fixed-k baseline
<=1% extra LUT and no new DSP
experiments.scope_change: All windows still classified in FPGA; synthetic recording joins are not physical onset; no inherited iid-SPRT guarantee

experiments.title: Interference envelope, then conditional bounded-stream wrapper
go_criteria: For admitted operating point: zero wrong outputs/gap/overflow/misses over 30000 scored windows
Mitigation claim requires admitted-envelope expansion or >=25% lower worst measured response at matched load
stop_criteria: No realistic contention issue: archive evidence without regulator project
experiments.scope_change: No latest-only dropping disguised as lossless; optional PL-paced replay is laboratory input, not real sensor acquisition

experiments.title: Preserve scarce physical evidence and choose one paper story
go_criteria: Selected physical variants archived with exact source/config/reference/input/output/timing identity
One coherent central question selected based on measured effect
experiments.scope_change: Archive only; unselected branches are not mandatory tasks

execution_note: run_command is null where no reviewed runnable harness yet exists. Output names describe planned artifacts and do not assert those files exist. Gates must be frozen before confirmation runs. Effort estimates overlap and are not promises or measured tool runtime.

confirmed_user_constraints.equipment_absence_policy: Keep scientifically useful ideas pending; prioritize current-board-plus-PC experiments, request faculty equipment in parallel. Missing gear does not scientifically falsify a hypothesis.

phased_schedule.faculty_queue: Request and confirm power logging, ADC/generator, independent timing and optional controlled rig/temperature access.
phased_schedule.decision: Pick finalists based on scientific gates.

phased_schedule.faculty_queue: Power pilot if appropriate instrument arrives; calibrate ADC/generator loopback if available.
phased_schedule.decision: Stop ineffective builds; preserve canonical baseline.

phased_schedule.faculty_queue: Perform equipment-dependent measurements only when protocol and calibration are ready.
phased_schedule.decision: Complete one defensible physical story; if access ends at 3 weeks, finalize archive now.

current_equipment: T01 physical only if offline gate wins
phased_schedule.faculty_queue: Complete ready equipment-backed confirmations without displacing final archive.
phased_schedule.decision: Freeze claims; avoid starting a major new branch.

schedule_caveat: Engineering planning estimate, not guaranteed elapsed time. Prioritize one main paper path and one backup; tool runtimes, training and route iteration remain uncertain.

equipment_request: Logging DC supply or time-stamped DC power meter
Calibrated shunt plus suitable DAQ as alternative
faculty_equipment_queue.question: Measured whole-board idle/loaded/active energy per accepted window at fixed workload.
faculty_equipment_queue.multimeter_role: Steady-state voltage/current and an initial mean estimate if range, burden and accuracy are known; a basic nonlogging meter does not establish per-window energy or transient peaks.
faculty_equipment_queue.access_gate: Confirm suitable instrument and calibrated measurement setup; otherwise retain pending, not scientifically rejected.

equipment_request: Calibrated signal generator or compatible digital replay source
faculty_equipment_queue.question: Actual acquisition-chain gain/clipping/lag transfer versus modeled raw24 input.
scientific_controls: Separate digital replay from analog performance
faculty_equipment_queue.access_gate: Confirm ingress and equipment compatibility; current raw24 model alone does not prove analog behavior.

equipment_request: Logic analyzer or oscilloscope appropriate for signals
faculty_equipment_queue.question: Independent edge/timestamp check of defined compute/transport boundaries.
scientific_controls: Explicit pulse semantics and instrumentation overhead
Independent reference clock or documented uncertainty
faculty_equipment_queue.access_gate: Useful optional validation; not a prerequisite for numerical pilots.

equipment_request: Controlled temperature environment and calibrated temperature observation
faculty_equipment_queue.question: Measured operating envelope within board/component rated conditions.
faculty_equipment_queue.access_gate: Proceed only with documented safe controlled setup; no improvised heating.

equipment_request: Documented healthy/fault labels and operating conditions
faculty_equipment_queue.question: Independent external-machine transfer evidence.
scientific_controls: Keep external dataset separate from MAFAULDA test
Unlabelled replay does not establish classification accuracy
faculty_equipment_queue.access_gate: Confirm rig, labels, operating permission and calibration; retain as a conditional extension.
